correctness.rationale: Almost surely both symbols recur. Except for two first occurrences, earliest-index nearest matches select the corresponding fixed first-hit index. Ergodic frequencies of adjacent symbol pairs yield the almost-sure limit. Exhaustive first-two-symbol partition gives the Bernoulli independence of anchor successors; this produces the four atoms and exact mean/variance. All boundaries, finite positive thresholds and ratio conventions are addressed. CHECK.py reproduces joint and moment formulas in exact rational arithmetic.

value.rationale: The exact asymptotic law resolves a motivated measurement-instability question for ordinary FNN under digitization. It exhibits a sharp interior parameter transition from deterministic saturation at fairness to genuinely random sample-specific saturation under any bias, with complete atom probabilities and variance, even though the underlying shift is ergodic. This distinguishes finite-observation degeneracy from underlying dynamical randomness and is more substantive than an isolated numerical failure.
